title: Arbitrary-Group CCA Security for Expanding Feistel Networks
summary: CCA security is established for two modular-addition combining operations; whether the expanding unbalanced Feistel result extends to arbitrary group operations remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Let $\Sigma$ be a non-binary alphabet with $d=|\Sigma|\ge 2$. For expanding unbalanced Feistel networks in the parameter regime $n\le m$, a CCA-security result is established when the combining operation is integer addition modulo $d^m$ or characterwise addition modulo $d$. Determine whether the same CCA-security result holds when the operation on $\Sigma^m$ is replaced by an arbitrary group operation; the existing proof does not cover this generalization.

scope.domain: CCA security of expanding unbalanced Feistel networks over non-binary alphabets.
parameters: n and m: network parameters defining the expanding regime n ≤ m
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the established CCA-security result extends from integer or characterwise modular addition to every group operation on Σ^m.

progress.summary: The paper establishes the expanding-case result for integer addition modulo d^m and characterwise addition modulo d. It then identifies arbitrary group operations as a case not covered by the existing proof.
citation_labels: Viet Tung Hoang et al., On Generalized Feistel Networks
